cs.t: "Growing up using 2 stroke weedeaters and chainsaws I had no idea how polluting they are." Terribly polluting.  However, my understanding is that there is no potential for "fixing" chainsaws since a 4 stroke engine cannot run upside down - which is a requirement for a chainsaw. Am I mistaken ? Luckily we're starting to see a lot of battery operated chainsaws come onto the market with higher density Li-ion batteries.  We're demoing a dewalt[1] chainsaw at my fire department and I have been using a Bosch reciprocating saw with a brush blade for light tree work for two years now ... but this is all light duty stuff and cannot replace large chainsaws... [1]  http://www.dewalt.com/products/power-tools/outdoor-power-equ...
